cases.title: a payment inside the mandate the principal signed: ok, with the mandate hash
NEGATIVE the agent writes its own mandate: signed by the agent's book
a mandate signed by a book that is not the principal's
a mandate citing a Grant version that is not the head
a mandate that outlives its Grant (notAfter beyond the Grant) is refused, not truncated
a mandate listing a beneficiary the Grant does not allow is refused
a payment after the mandate's notAfter (Grant still in force): mandate_expired
a payment to a Grant-allowed vendor the mandate does not list
a payment above the mandate's per-payment limit (tighter than the Grant)
a mandate with an unknown member is malformed
C5: the agent record binds the signed mandate hash
C5 NEGATIVE: a record binding the agent's own stated intent instead of the mandate is refused
C5: a record with no instruction hash is refused by name
L1 bound: a mandate whose cumulative cap is above the Grant cap for the same period is refused
L1 bound: a mandate cumulative over another period than the Grant cannot be compared and is refused
L1 enforce: the mandate lineage ledger consumption of the window plus this payment passes the mandate cap
L2 NEGATIVE: the old wide mandate presented after the principal wrote a narrower version: superseded
L2: the narrower head itself is honoured, and its own tighter limit applies
L2 NEGATIVE: after a withdrawal (an empty-validity version) the earlier mandate is refused as withdrawn
L2 NEGATIVE: the withdrawal version presented as a mandate is refused as withdrawn
L2: two mandate lineages for the same agent and grantId: ambiguous, refused (never the widest)
L3: an exact exception lifts the mandate per-payment limit for that one transaction (40,000 to a listed vendor)
L3 NEGATIVE: an exception payment to a beneficiary the mandate does not list is denied even with two officers
L3: a band exception does not lift the mandate per-payment limit
L3: an exception never lifts the mandate cumulative cap
L4 recheck: nothing changed while pending: unchanged
L4 recheck: the mandate was superseded while the payment was pending: denied before final approval
L4 recheck: the mandate was withdrawn while pending: denied
L4 recheck: the mandate expired while pending: denied
L4 recheck: other payments exhausted the mandate cap while this one was pending: denied
L4 recheck: a CERTIFIED payment whose mandate was later superseded is not re-decided: exposure window open
